notes.title: ver 1.9.11
notes.content: In this update, the technicians fixed some hidden bugs in the game, improving its stability.

notes.title: The DLC for Yakuza Rogue2 has been officially released today
notes.content:
The game has added exclusive storylines for two female characters. You can go to the gym after the massage parlor closes at 8:00 PM. At the gym, you can enhance the main character's attributes and interact with the new female characters.
If your relationship with the new character is close enough, something very special might happen in the massage parlor's break room~

notes.title: "Yakuza Rogue 2" has officially launched
notes.content:
The initial discount will last for two weeks, and we hope everyone can show their support.
The uncensored version, which many of you are concerned about, is still in production and is expected to be available by mid to late June.
The bundle pack will go online later today (Yakuza Rogue 1&2). Players who haven't purchased Yakuza Rogue 1 (Self Defense Dojo) can buy the bundle pack with an additional 10% discount!
DLC has been uploaded and will be available online as soon as it passes Steam's review.
The achievement system is currently in production and is expected to be released within two weeks.
The collectible card system will be developed after the game achieves a certain level of sales, so we ask for your patience.
The Portuguese version will be available next week, and we would like to express our special thanks to Thiago for their translation support. We would like to express our special thanks to Scorch for helping us with English translation and edengenesis for their free proofreading assistance. Thank you very much!

notes.title: The Steam version is coming soon!
notes.content:
The Steam version of "Yakuza Rogue: Yokohama massage parlor chapter" is actively being prepared and is expected to be released by the end of May! The five beautiful female characters in the game will be waiting for you at the bar~
